# Pixel Elevator Panel

A pixel-art style elevator control panel for floors 1–6. Press floor buttons to queue them; the car moves one floor per second toward the next queued floor, shows the current floor and direction, and opens its doors on arrival.

## Features

- Floor buttons 1–6 with queued (pending) visual state
- One-floor-per-second movement toward the next queued floor
- Live current floor and direction (up/down/idle) display
- Door open animation on arrival
- Keyboard-accessible controls with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- No external dependencies, works fully offline

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

## Controls

- Click or focus + Enter/Space on a floor button to queue that floor.
- Pending floors are highlighted with a blinking dot.
- The display shows the current floor and direction arrow.
- Doors open briefly when the car arrives at a queued floor.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure
- `styles.css` – pixel-art themed styling
- `app.js` – elevator logic and queue engine
